title: Settings — new icons for Backup & Sync and Remote Access

steps.path: Settings → the Backup & Sync and Remote Access rows
steps.headline: Backup & Sync and Remote Access now have icons like every other settings row.
steps.changed: Backup & Sync shows a cloud with an upward arrow. Remote Access shows a phone with signal waves. Both are drawn in the same thin grey outline style as Sound, Help and the rest.
steps.measured: 16 px icons, same line weight (1.8) as the other rows
steps.notice: The settings list reads as one matching column of icons, with no coloured dots breaking it up.
steps.risk: The status is less eye-catching from a distance now that the dot is small and sits beside the text instead of in the icon spot.

steps.path: Settings → the Backup & Sync and Remote Access rows
steps.headline: The status dot now sits on the second line, just left of "Last synced…" or "Connected".
steps.changed: The dot moved from the icon spot down to the start of the grey status line, and got smaller to match that text. Colours are unchanged: green is good, red is a problem, grey is off.
steps.measured: Dot shrank from 10 px to 6 px
steps.notice: The dot reads as part of the status sentence it describes. The test screen shows red "Sync Failing" and grey "Disabled"; yours will show green when things are working.
steps.risk: When the status text is long and gets cut off with "…", the dot still shows, so nothing is lost there. On a phone the rows look the same.
